Gemini's free tier allows 20 generate_content requests PER DAY per model (quotaId GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier, quotaValue 20). The run issued 120, so 100 returned HTTP 429 and only 20 produced an answer - the reported recall of 0.1818 is 2 correct out of 11 usable novel cases. Those 100 are excluded from the denominator rather than scored wrong (invariant 6), which is why the non-answers column reads 100 and the number must not be read without it. The BASELINE row on this sample is valid (recall 0.4667, false-alarm 0.0167) because it makes no API calls. Superseded by data/validation_novel_eval_groq.json.
